items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: Yeah, that man rings a bell, but I've forgotten what you talked about.

ctx.x: He played with all the, the local bands around here.
Yeah, he never did talk much about them until I got to know him well. Which I was especially close to him. And Willie Tyson, did you ever know him? A piano player?
Yeah, that man rings a bell, but I've forgotten what you talked about. Yes.
